svg.title: Отжимания с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Fix resistance band route: flat loop crosses upper BACK over shoulder blades, never front chest or neck. Draw rear three-quarter view so both phases show band across shoulder blades and sides descending continuously to hands pinned on floor. Preserve feet on toes and straight body, straight elbows left, bent elbows right. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
